detail.longDescription: 📰 New Steam Client Update Introduces Linux 64-Bit Support, Steam Achievement Sets Valve released a new stable Steam Client update today with a 64-bit build for Linux systems, Steam Achievement Sets, support for GameInput v4, and more. 📰 Source: 9to5Linux 🔗 Link: https://9to5linux.com/new-steam-client-update-introduces-linux-64-bit-support-steam-achievement-sets # Linux # OpenSource # SteamDeck # PCGaming
